gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (p4) prints transfers gross per fund: Interfund transfer in General 21,701 + Park 20,722 = 42,423; Interfund transfer out General (76,208) + Park (21,701) = (97,909). The budget schedules print only each fund's NET transfer as an outflow: General Fund 'Interfund transfers' 54,507 (p8; 76,208 - 21,701) and Park Fund 'Interfund transfers in' 979 (p10, subtracted as an outflow; 21,701 - 20,722). No schedule prints a gross transfer in, so detail transfers in = 0 vs statement 42,423. The 42,423 is the same amount netted out of both sides (out 97,909 - 42,423 = 55,486 = 54,507 + 979). Printed netting; no fix.

Statement (p4) transfers out gross 97,909 (General 76,208 + Park 21,701). Schedules print net outflows: General 54,507 (p8) + Park 979 (p10) = 55,486 (detail indexes 11 and 23). 97,909 - 55,486 = 42,423 = the gross transfers in that the schedules net against the outs. Printed netting; no fix.
